nodes.label: Trigger when user mentions group interview keywords or provides a product/operation/business discussion topic
Generate a structured group‑interview solution document (markdown) with 5 sections: keyword analysis, time plan, outline, content, and mind‑map
Use Xmind MCP (mcp__xmind__xmind_create_mindmap) to create a mind‑map of the solution framework
Automatically save the generated markdown to ./outputs/pm-group-interview/ with naming convention pm-group-interview_{keywords}_{timestamp}.md and include yaml front‑matter
